records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、あそこ、見て……！
records.en_original: Look, Hiori. Over there!
records.en_auxiliary: Look, Hiori. Over there!
records.en: Hiori-san, look over there...!

records.jp: 記憶のかけら！<CR>これでお姉ちゃんが笑った切っ掛けがわかるはず……！
records.en_original: A memory! This should give me a clue as to what made Mio laugh!
records.en_auxiliary: A memory! This should give me a clue as to what made Mio laugh!
records.en: A memory shard!<CR>This should tell us what made Onee-chan laugh...!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん、今日はすごくいい天気だね！<CR>海もきらきらしてて……きれいだね！
records.en_original: The weather is so nice today! And the ocean is so sparkly... It's so pretty.
records.en_auxiliary: The weather is so nice today! And the ocean is so sparkly... It's so pretty.
records.en: Onee-chan, the weather is so nice today!<CR>The sea is sparkling too... It's beautiful!

records.jp: ……陽桜莉が楽しいのなら、よかった
records.en_original: I'm glad you're having fun.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad you're having fun.
records.en: ...I'm glad, if you're having fun, Hiori.

records.jp: 美弦さんと海に来てた……っぽいけど。<CR>あんまり笑う雰囲気じゃ、ない……？
records.en_original: Seems like you went to the beach with Mio, but...doesn't seem like either of your are in the laughing mood.
records.en_auxiliary: Seems like you went to the beach with Mio, but...doesn't seem like either of your are in the laughing mood.
records.en: It looks like you came to the beach with Mio-san...<CR>but it doesn't really feel like the kind of mood where she'd laugh...?

records.jp: この記憶……。思い出した……。<CR>お母さんがいなくなった後、二人で海に来た時の……
records.en_original: This memory... I remember now. We came to the beach after Mom left.
records.en_auxiliary: This memory... I remember now. We came to the beach after Mom left.
records.en: This memory... I remember now...<CR>It's from when the two of us came to the beach after Mom left...

records.jp: ……そうだ！
records.en_original: Oh!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh!
records.en: ...That's it!

records.jp: 陽桜莉、急に走ったら危な……
records.en_original: Hiori? Don't just run off by yourself—
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori? Don't just run off by yourself—
records.en: Hiori, it's dangerous if you suddenly start running—

records.jp: ……！？　陽桜莉、待って！<CR>そのままじゃ海に……
records.en_original: Wait... Hiori, no! You're headed straight for the water!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait... Hiori, no! You're headed straight for the water!
records.en: ...!? Hiori, wait!<CR>At this rate you'll run right into the sea...!

records.jp: …………陽桜莉、なにしてるの？<CR>全身ずぶ濡れじゃない
records.en_original: What in the world are you doing? You're completely drenched.
records.en_auxiliary: What in the world are you doing? You're completely drenched.
records.en: ......Hiori, what are you doing?<CR>You're soaking wet all over.

records.jp: えへへ。今日はお母さんが一緒じゃないから<CR>怒られないなーって思って
records.en_original: Hehe. I just thought since Mom's not here, she can't get mad at us for getting our clothes wet.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I just thought since Mom's not here, she can't get mad at us for getting our clothes wet.
records.en: Ehehe. I thought since Mom isn't with us today,<CR>I won't get scolded.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんも一緒にやろうよ！　ねっ！
records.en_original: You should join me, Mio! Come on!
records.en_auxiliary: You should join me, Mio! Come on!
records.en: You should do it too, Onee-chan! C'mon!

records.jp: えっ……！　陽桜莉、ちょっと待っ……
records.en_original: What? Hiori, wait!
records.en_auxiliary: What? Hiori, wait!
records.en: Wha—! Hiori, wait a—

records.jp: ……そうだった。私、お姉ちゃんを誘って、<CR>服を着たまま海に入ったんだっけ
records.en_original: That's right... I made her come with me into the water with all of our clothes still on.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right... I made her come with me into the water with all of our clothes still on.
records.en: ...Right. I asked Onee-chan to join me,<CR>and we went into the sea with our clothes still on.

records.jp: 楽しかったね、お姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: That was fun!
records.en_auxiliary: That was fun!
records.en: That was fun, Onee-chan!

records.jp: お母さんがいない今しかできない悪いこと、<CR>いっぱいしようね！
records.en_original: Now we can do all the stuff that Mom would've gotten mad at us for!
records.en_auxiliary: Now we can do all the stuff that Mom would've gotten mad at us for!
records.en: Let's do lots of naughty things<CR>that we can only do now that Mom isn't here!

records.jp: 陽桜莉……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: あは、あはははは！
records.en_original: Haha... Ahahahaha!
records.en_auxiliary: Haha... Ahahahaha!
records.en: Aha, ahahahaha!

records.jp: お、お姉ちゃん？
records.en_original: Er, M-Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Er, M-Mio?
records.en: O-Onee-chan?

records.jp: ふふ……ううん、陽桜莉の言うとおりだなって思って
records.en_original: Hehe... You know what? You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... You know what? You're right.
records.en: Hehe... No, I was just thinking that you're right, Hiori.

records.jp: ありがとう、陽桜莉
records.en_original: Thank you, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Hiori.
records.en: Thank you, Hiori.

records.jp: …………あれ？　これで終わり？
records.en_original: Huh? Is that it?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Is that it?
records.en: ...Huh? Is that it?

records.jp: 特別なにかをしたわけじゃなくて……<CR>海に飛び込んで、笑われただけ？
records.en_original: I guess I didn't really do anything special... I just jumped into the ocean.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I didn't really do anything special... I just jumped into the ocean.
records.en: It's not like I did anything special...<CR>I just jumped into the sea and got laughed at?

records.jp: ご、ごめん、愛央ちゃん。<CR>私、なにか勘違いしてたみたいで……
records.en_original: S-sorry, Ao. This was completely different from what I was expecting.
records.en_auxiliary: S-sorry, Ao. This was completely different from what I was expecting.
records.en: S-sorry, Ao-chan.<CR>Looks like I misunderstood something...

records.jp: ううん。これだよ、陽桜莉さん
records.en_original: No, Hiori, that's it!
records.en_auxiliary: No, Hiori, that's it!
records.en: No, this is it, Hiori-san.

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 前にも言ったけど、陽桜莉さんのこういうとこに<CR>みんな助けられてるんだよ！
records.en_original: This is the part of you that helps everyone around you.
records.en_auxiliary: This is the part of you that helps everyone around you.
records.en: Like I told you before, this side of you, Hiori-san,<CR>is what helps everyone!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんが陽桜莉さんらしくしてれば、<CR>それだけで元気をもらえる。これが答えなんだよ
records.en_original: You make us all happy just being who you are. That's the answer.
records.en_auxiliary: You make us all happy just being who you are. That's the answer.
records.en: As long as you're being Hiori-san,<CR>that alone gives people energy. That's the answer.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Ao-chan...

records.jp: 私が、私らしくいれば……
records.en_original: The way I am...
records.en_auxiliary: The way I am...
records.en: If I just stay true to myself...

records.jp: ……そっか。そうだよね！
records.en_original: Yeah... You're right!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... You're right!
records.en: ...I see. You're right!

records.jp: 一生懸命頑張る！　諦めない！<CR>そうすれば、どんなこともきっとうまくいく！
records.en_original: If I just do my best and don't give up, everything will turn out fine! I won't give up!
records.en_auxiliary: If I just do my best and don't give up, everything will turn out fine! I won't give up!
records.en: I'll do my best! I won't give up!<CR>If I do that, I'm sure everything will work out!

records.jp: 私は……
records.en_original: I believe...
records.en_auxiliary: I believe...

records.jp: 私は、未来を信じる……！
records.en_original: I believe in the future!
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in the future!
records.en: I believe in the future...!

records.jp: ……うんっ！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: ...Yeah!

records.jp: 信じよう！　見たかった未来はきっと来る！<CR>私たちは、どこまでだって進んでいける！
records.en_original: The future I want will come some day! We can overcome all this together!
records.en_auxiliary: The future I want will come some day! We can overcome all this together!
records.en: Let's believe in it! The future we wanted will come someday!<CR>We can keep moving forward, no matter how far!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、ここまで付き合ってくれてありがとう
records.en_original: Thanks for sticking with me, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks for sticking with me, Ao.
records.en: Ao-chan, thanks for sticking with me this far.

records.jp: 今……なんかすごくスッキリした気持ち。<CR>それに、みんなを元気にする方法もわかったかも！
records.en_original: I...feel like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders. And I think I have an idea for cheering everyone up!
records.en_auxiliary: I...feel like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders. And I think I have an idea for cheering everyone up!
records.en: Right now... I somehow feel really refreshed.<CR>And I think I may have figured out how to cheer everyone up!

records.jp: ……ふふっ！<CR>こんなの見たら、やることは一つだもんね！
records.en_original: Hehe! I mean, after what we saw, we don't have much of a choice!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe! I mean, after what we saw, we don't have much of a choice!
records.en: ...Hehe!<CR>After seeing this, there's only one thing to do!

records.jp: あははっ！　つっめたい！　気持ちいい！
records.en_original: Hahaha! That's cold! But it feels so nice!
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha! That's cold! But it feels so nice!
records.en: Ahaha! C-cold! But it feels great!

records.jp: ちょっと、こっちにまで水が飛んでる！
records.en_original: Hey, you're splashing me too!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, you're splashing me too!
records.en: Hey, you're splashing me too!

records.jp: たまにはこういうのもいいね～
records.en_original: This is a nice change of pace, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: This is a nice change of pace, isn't it?
records.en: This is nice every once in a while~

records.jp: みんな笑ってくれてるね
records.en_original: Look at that. Everyone's smiling.
records.en_auxiliary: Look at that. Everyone's smiling.
records.en: Everyone's smiling.

records.jp: だってこれ、めっちゃ楽しいもん！
records.en_original: Duh! This is so much fun!
records.en_auxiliary: Duh! This is so much fun!
records.en: Because this is super fun!

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃんも、笑顔だね。<CR>よかった。私、愛央ちゃんのその顔が見たかったんだ
records.en_original: You've got a big smile on your face yourself. I'm glad my plan worked.
records.en_auxiliary: You've got a big smile on your face yourself. I'm glad my plan worked.
records.en: ...You're smiling too, Ao-chan.<CR>I'm glad. That's the look I wanted to see on your face.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: あっ……お姉ちゃん、休憩しようとしてる。<CR>まだまだ休ませないぞ～！
records.en_original: Oh, looks like Mio is trying to take a break. Not on my watch!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, looks like Mio is trying to take a break. Not on my watch!
records.en: Ah... Onee-chan's trying to take a break.<CR>I'm not letting her rest just yet~!

records.jp: （……陽桜莉さんがいると、みんなが笑顔になれる）
records.en_original: (Everyone smiles whenever Hiori's around.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Everyone smiles whenever Hiori's around.)
records.en: (...When Hiori-san is around, everyone smiles.)

records.jp: （どこまでも真っ直ぐで、優しくて……<CR>それから、強い心を持っている人）
records.en_original: (She's so genuine and kind, with a strong heart.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's so genuine and kind, with a strong heart.)
records.en: (She's always so sincere and kind...<CR>and she has such a strong heart.)

records.jp: （やっぱり陽桜莉さんは、眩しいなぁ……）
records.en_original: (She really is radiant.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She really is radiant.)
records.en: (Hiori-san really is radiant...)

records.jp: ……あれ？　タオルがない
records.en_original: ...Hm? There aren't any towels.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hm? There aren't any towels.
records.en: ...Huh? There aren't any towels.

records.jp: しまった！　全部洗濯してたんだった！
records.en_original: Oh, shoot! They're still all in the laundry!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, shoot! They're still all in the laundry!
records.en: Oh no! I put them all in the wash!

records.jp: えええ！！！
records.en_original: Whaaat?!
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaat?!
records.en: Whaaaat!!!

records.jp: ごめんなさーい！<CR>やっぱり、もうちょっと考えて行動しますー！
records.en_original: I'm so sorry! I promise I'll plan better next time!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so sorry! I promise I'll plan better next time!
records.en: I'm sorryyy!<CR>I really will think a little more before I act!
